actions.label: Review Preserve display wake behavior while Awake keeps the system awake
actions.note: Queues the design workflow for maintainer approval; no upstream write occurs.

prerequisites: Record Windows display-off and sleep timeout settings; use the same settings for Awake-on and Awake-off runs.
Keep Awake's Keep screen on setting off.
steps: Enable Awake, leave Keep screen on off, wait for the display timeout, and attempt wake via keyboard/mouse/power button.
Record whether the system is still awake and inspect execution-state requests around display-off/wake.
Repeat with Awake disabled under identical power settings.
Repeat with Keep screen on enabled as a control.
reproduce.expected_result: With Keep screen on off, display can turn off and then wake normally; Awake does not leave the display stuck off.

evidence: PowerToys 0.98.1 from Microsoft Store on Windows 11 25H2; not running elevated.
Repro uses Awake on, Keep screen on off, waits for display-off, then wakes via keyboard, mouse, or power button.
Reporter confirmed on 2026-10-14 that the display works normally when Awake is turned off.
AwakeStateCalculator uses ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED without ES_DISPLAY_REQUIRED when Keep screen on is false.
judgment.rationale: The reporter confirms the display wakes normally when Awake is disabled, so the problem is associated with the Awake-enabled scenario. AwakeStateCalculator correctly uses only ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED when Keep screen on is off; this should allow the display to power down, but the wake failure is not explained by that source branch.

title: Keep screen on during awake issue

fix_assessment.rationale: A code correction may be appropriate, but the confidence and uncertainty are stated in the proposed plan.

confidence.rationale: The A/B user observation links the symptom to Awake, but the inspected state calculation appears to honor the display-off setting and no failing transition is known.

proposed_fixes.title: Preserve display wake behavior while Awake keeps the system awake
verification: With Awake on and Keep screen on off, verify display powers down at the configured timeout and wakes from keyboard, mouse, or power button.
Verify Awake still prevents system sleep during its configured duration and Keep screen on on still prevents display-off.
plan: Reproduce on a current Windows 11 build with the reporter's display timeout settings and compare Awake enabled/disabled.
Trace SetThreadExecutionState requests and session/power event handling across display-off and wake; confirm Keep screen on false never adds ES_DISPLAY_REQUIRED.
If a PowerToys state transition is shown to block wake, correct that transition and add a regression test for display-off/wake with system keep-awake enabled.
If the failure occurs outside the PowerToys power request path, document and route accordingly rather than changing code.
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Red hypothesis: Awake's continuous system-required power request or its state reapplication around display power events may interact with display wake, despite correctly omitting ES_DISPLAY_REQUIRED when Keep screen on is disabled. No faulty transition is confirmed.

known_information: PowerToys 0.98.1 from Microsoft Store on Windows 11 25H2; not running elevated.
Repro uses Awake on, Keep screen on off, waits for display-off, then wakes via keyboard, mouse, or power button.
Reporter confirmed on 2026-10-14 that the display works normally when Awake is turned off.
AwakeStateCalculator uses ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED without ES_DISPLAY_REQUIRED when Keep screen on is false.
issue_context.analysis: The A/B behavior supports maintainer-side reproduction. Do not infer that Awake requests the display remain on; instrument the execution-state transition and verify the Windows power configuration before selecting a fix.
inferences: The symptom correlates with Awake being active, but current source shows the display-required flag is intentionally absent when the setting is off; the cause may involve power-request lifecycle or another system component.
issue_context.summary: With Awake active and Keep screen on disabled, the display turns off but reportedly fails to wake; the reporter says wake works when Awake is disabled.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue body and maintainer follow-up; reporter confirmed the Awake-disabled control condition.
Inspected AwakeStateCalculator.ComputeAwakeState: false keepDisplayOn yields ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED | ES_CONTINUOUS, without ES_DISPLAY_REQUIRED.
No exact Windows display timeout configuration or source cause was established.
